title: Juicy Crisp Egyptian Chicken Flatbread
description: A crispy and flavorful Egyptian dish featuring chicken and long-fermentation-dough, perfect for a date night, and friendly to Buddhist temple dietary preferences.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast, warm water, and let it sit for 10 minutes until frothy.
Add flour, salt, and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it, and let it rise in a warm place for 2 hours.
Season the chicken breast with thyme, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Bake the chicken in the oven for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Brush the pita bread with olive oil and toast until crispy.
Assemble the flatbread by slicing the chicken and placing it on top of the toasted pita bread.
